[ASSISTANT_SAID] Suggested recipe ideas for vegan lasagna:  
[ASSISTANT_CREATED] 1. Roasted Vegetable Lasagna: Layers of roasted eggplant, zucchini, bell peppers, and onions, with a dairy-free ricotta made from cashew cream or tofu.  
[ASSISTANT_CREATED] 2. Mushroom and Lentil Bolognese Lasagna: A hearty, meat-free bolognese sauce made with sautéed mushrooms and lentils, layered with vegan ricotta and spinach.  
[ASSISTANT_CREATED] 3. Spinach and Artichoke Lasagna: A creamy, cheesy (vegan) lasagna featuring artichoke hearts, spinach, and a dairy-free bechamel sauce.  
[ASSISTANT_CREATED] 4. Vegan Meatball Lasagna: A twist on the classic, with vegan meatballs made from oats, vegetables, and spices, layered with marinara sauce and dairy-free mozzarella.  
[ASSISTANT_CREATED] 5. Butternut Squash and Sage Lasagna: A seasonal, comforting option featuring roasted butternut squash, sage, and a creamy cashew-based bechamel sauce.

[ASSISTANT_SAID] Additional tips for making vegan lasagna:  
[ASSISTANT_CREATED] - Use a variety of vegetables to add texture and flavor.
